gloss: bridge of the nose; nose ridge

definitions.gloss: bridge of the nose; nose ridge
definitions.explanation: The line running from between the eyes down to the tip of the nose. A key feature in descriptions of facial appearance, especially in discussions of beauty and cosmetics.

examples.japanese: {鼻筋|はなすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧。
examples.english: The nose bridge is straight and well-defined.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鼻筋|はなすじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{通|とお}った→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{美人|びじん}→美人：01600_bijin⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a beauty with a well-defined nose bridge.

examples.japanese: ⟦メイク→メイク：11163_meiku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{鼻筋|はなすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ハイライト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立体的|りったいてき}→立体的：20747_rittaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: If you apply highlighter along the bridge of your nose, your face looks more three-dimensional.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧ (nose) + ⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧ (line/ridge). A straight, well-defined nose bridge ({鼻筋|はなすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧) is considered an attractive facial feature in Japanese beauty standards.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鼻筋|はなすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}っている→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to have a straight/well-defined nose bridge
- {鼻筋|はなすじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ハイライト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to apply highlighter along the nose bridge
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{鼻筋|はなすじ}: a high nose bridge
- {鼻筋|はなすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ: to have a beautiful nose line

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鼻|はな}→鼻：02164_hana⟧: nose — the overall feature
- {小鼻|こばな}: nostrils/nose wings — the flared sides of the nose
- {鼻先|はなさき}: tip of the nose — the very end
